name: tools-human-readable-map16-v0-1
title: Human Readable Map16 v0.1.0
description:
A command line tool for converting Lunar Magic's full-game-export map16 files to a human readable text format and back.

For basic usage see the included README.md (you can open .md files with notepad if you don't have a way to view markdown files specifically).

Note that currently, only full-game-export map16 files are supported (blue question mark block in Lunar Magic's map16 editor).

For source code see the github repo in the website field.

Works well with Lunar Helper v1.1.0 and Lunar Monitor v0.4.0, which can automatically convert to and from this format.
